basis: Item 8 draft, 2026-10-29. A sheet that is not too flat: flatness (mean z over peak z inside the patch) at most 0.55. The three recorded canopies read 0.45, 0.46 and 0.61 while natural bright patches are smooth (q0.05 of sheet false alarms is 0.59); the injection hits sit at a median of 0.615 against the false alarms' 0.94. A canopy has folds and a saturated centre; a bright patch of ground has neither. Kept beside the adopted saturation rule.
